Green: 517/517 passing. Two commits broke it; I fixed the source in each and left the tests alone.

- **`958d3ae` (thousands separators):** `formatMoney` padded the cents with `padEnd` instead of `padStart`, so 1 cent came out as `$0.10`. I changed it to `padStart` in `src/money.js`. The comma grouping is kept.
- **`4188e9a` (per-line discounts):** `buildInvoice` set `taxable = subtotal`, so tax was charged before the order-level code (SPRING10 and similar) came off. I changed it to `subtotal - discount` in `src/invoice.js`. The line-discount support, `lineDiscounts` and the empty-items check are kept.

The 8 failures were all these two bugs; the render failures were downstream of them. I didn't commit anything.
